name: pcb-agent-workflow
description: KiCad 10 + JLCPCB workflow skills for Claude Code and Codex: JLC support messages, production file review, readable schematics, enclosure STEP export.

plugins.name: jlc-support
plugins.description: Draft verifiable, boundary-marked messages to JLCPCB support and engineers; compute confirmation deadlines. Sending and confirming always wait for the user.

plugins.name: jlc-production-review
plugins.description: Diff JLCPCB production files and parts placement against the fixed release, classify every change, and check BOM/CPL. Bundles the CAM diff scripts.

plugins.name: readable-schematic-layout
plugins.description: Redraw KiCad schematics and layouts for human debugging, and prove the circuit is unchanged with netlist and pin-to-pad checks.

plugins.name: kicad-enclosure-step
plugins.description: Export a KiCad board as a STEP with every part modelled, for enclosure design: inventory missing models, add them on a temporary copy, verify each placement against its footprint.

plugins.name: jlc-send-guard
plugins.description: Optional Claude Code hook: asks for confirmation before any Gmail send, reply or forward tool runs. Off by default; does not cover browser clicks.
